components.name: Landing Primary Button
components.description: Square, confident entry action for marketing surfaces.
components.css: .ds-landing-button { height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #315f6c; color: #f2f4f7; padding: 0 16px; font: 700 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-landing-button:hover { background: #3d7781; } .ds-landing-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ac9ce; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editor Selected Tool
components.description: Compact selected state for the editor tool rail.
components.css: .ds-tool-selected { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #159f9f; color: #151a22; font: 700 10px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-selected:hover { background: #39bebd; } .ds-tool-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #72d9d5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editor Ghost Tool
components.description: Quiet icon or text action for dense editor command surfaces.
components.css: .ds-tool-ghost { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #a5aebb; font: 600 10px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tool-ghost:hover { border-color: #3b4554; background: #28303d; color: #f2f4f7; } .ds-tool-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #39bebd; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editor Text Field
components.description: Compact dark field for project, variation, and inspector values.
components.css: .ds-editor-field { height: 36px; width: 220px; border: 1px solid #3b4554; border-radius: 6px; background: #1d2430; color: #f2f4f7; padding: 0 8px; font: 600 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-editor-field:hover { border-color: #596477; } .ds-editor-field:focus-visible { border-color: #159f9f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #39bebd; }

components.name: Technical Badge
components.description: Square production label used for concise proof and context.
components.css: .ds-technical-badge { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #496879; border-radius: 0; background: #121f2a; color: #86b8bb; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Editor Panel
components.description: Flat operational container separated by tone and borders.
components.css: .ds-editor-panel { width: 304px; border: 1px solid #28303d; border-radius: 0; background: #1d2430; color: #f2f4f7; padding: 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-editor-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-editor-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #7b8798; font-size: 12px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Landing Header
components.description: Dark architectural header with uppercase identity and one clear action.
components.css: .ds-landing-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #36515f; background: #101d27; color: #f2f4f7; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-landing-nav strong { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-landing-nav strong span { margin-left: 8px; color: #70aeb2; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.32em; } .ds-landing-nav button { height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #315f6c; color: #f2f4f7; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-landing-nav button:hover { background: #3d7781; } .ds-landing-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9ac9ce; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
InkMaster Studio feels like a focused production bench after dark: cool, precise, and built around the artwork rather than decorative interface chrome. Deep navy and charcoal surfaces establish a controlled working field, while cyan-teal signals bring selected tools, trusted actions, and print-readiness into focus.

The landing page expresses this world at poster scale through oversized uppercase type, a technical grid, and a garment stage. The editor compresses the same identity into a dense operating environment with compact controls, disciplined panels, and clear state changes. Refinements should preserve this relationship rather than introducing a new visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Nocturnal navy and charcoal surface hierarchy
Cyan-teal signals used with restraint and purpose
Technical grid, measurement, and production-bench cues
Bold uppercase marketing type paired with compact sentence-case controls
Square presentation surfaces with gently rounded operational controls

rules.name: The Cool Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal and emerald identify action, selection, focus, or readiness. They do not become decorative surface fills.

rules.name: The Night Field Rule
rules.body: Product and interface chrome stay dark so uploaded artwork remains the brightest and most variable object in the experience.

rules.name: The Tool Voice Rule
rules.body: Marketing speaks in bold uppercase blocks; controls and guidance use compact sentence case. Do not make the editor shout.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tone and one-pixel borders first. Add a strong shadow only when a surface physically overlays, slides over, or stages another object.

rules.name: The Contextual Corner Rule
rules.body: Presentation surfaces stay architectural and square; operational controls may curve gently. Avoid large soft cards and pill-shaped containers.

dos: Do preserve the dark production-bench hierarchy across landing and editor surfaces.
Do reserve teal and emerald for clear interaction and readiness signals.
Do use thin borders, grid lines, and measurements to communicate precision.
Do keep editor controls compact, direct, and keyboard-visible.
Do let real artwork and garment imagery carry the visual variety.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent identity with glossy neon SaaS styling.
Don't introduce playful craft-marketplace motifs or soft scrapbook decoration.
Don't flatten the system into sterile monochrome minimalism.
Don't turn every panel into a rounded floating card.
Don't use accent color as broad decoration or compete with the artwork.
